svg.title: DIA-003 · The runout
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a rock face in section. A lead climber is high on the face, just above a level marked frontier. Ledges below are marked GPT-3, ChatGPT and GPT-4. The rope runs down to four anchors clustered near the ground, the highest just above the level marked routine, and then to a belayer. A rust dimension line marks the long stretch of rope between the last anchor and the climber: the runout.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 3 · WHAT'S UNSOLVED AT THAT SPEED
a. The lead: what the newest models can do. b. Anchors: what we can ensure. c. The belay: whoever has to catch it. Heights are judged, not measured.
DIA-003 · The gap does not predict a slip. It sets what a slip would cost, and it grows with every move made above the last anchor.
